title: The Horde
overview:
35 minutes of live-action digitized video sequences. Hilarious action-strategy mayhem!

The Horde mixes town building with sword-swinging action. As Chauncey, a humble servant rewarded by the king with a plot of land, you must grow a village while ravenous red Hordlings try to devour its cows, crops and people. Each season opens with a short timed build phase for walls, traps and landscaping, then you take up your great sword and fight off the attacking waves. Gather the money that falls from slain Hordlings, spend it on magic items, pay the chancellor's taxes, and lead new settlements through five regions of the kingdom.
